plain_english: Filled with rest of beginning-end-entered endless power — unspeakable — I study speech: the Lord's heart.
sanskrit_cite: ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām anuccāryām | ahaṃ vācam adhīye hṛdayaṃ vibhoḥ

plain_english: He indeed Bhairava god; all gods of-whom-made. That very Bhairavī — being, non-being too — of-whom-made.
sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devas sarve devāś ca yanmayāḥ | saivāsau bhairavī sattāsattāpi ca yanmayī

plain_english: That indeed Bhairava's knowledge-ignorance too of-whom-made. He indeed Bhairava-doctrine — opponent too of-whom-made.
sanskrit_cite: tad eva bhairavaṃ jñānam ajñānam api yanmayam | sa hi bhairavasiddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣo 'pi yanmayaḥ

plain_english: Unity of six paths — where that Bhairavī abides — at the end of all systems — ineffable, supreme goal.
sanskrit_cite: aikadhyam adhvanāṃ ṣa.ṅnāṃ yatra sā bhairavī sthitiḥ | paryante sarvatantrāṇām avācyā paramā gatiḥ

plain_english: She — bliss-only-self-merged will-knowledge-true-action — heart of god-of-gods, of Bhairava, undivided ground.
From nature of consciousness, that god by own self reflecting — Lord, from unattached to end-of-stages — stages attains.
sanskrit_cite: citsvābhāvyād asau devaḥ svātmanā vimṛṣan prabhuḥ | anāśritādibhūmyantā bhūmikāḥ pratipadyate

plain_english: There expressive, expressed, self — of two vibrations singly — of Lord gross, subtle, supreme appearance — of sequences sixfold path.
sanskrit_cite: tatra vācakavācyātmaspandayor ekaśaḥ | prabhoḥ sthūlasūkṣmaparābhāsakramayoḥ ṣaḍvidhādhvatā
